title: NE555 Astable LED Flasher
goal: A practitioner can visually assess the NE555 Astable LED Flasher scenario using its published diagram convention.

rubric.must: A solderless breadboard with labelled physical components and colored jumper wires is visible.
Red positive-supply wiring and black ground-return wiring are visibly distinct.
The visible signal path connects the controller or IC to the named load or module.
The picture visibly places the current-limiting or timing component in the intended circuit path rather than as an unconnected part.
Parts and wire endpoints visibly land on breadboard tie points without ambiguous floating connections.

ideal.notes: Target review blocked on source data: The source declares a half-size board but addresses column 38; timing resistors are not wired into the oscillator, and reset/trigger/discharge connections are incomplete. Do not silently repair the source in a target drawing.
